title: The pig equipment supplier for modern pig production - Big Dutchman - Home - The Pig Site | The Pig Site
content: Big Dutchman is considered the world’s leading supplier of equipment and feeding systems for modern pig and poultry production. The family enterprise’s range of products includes traditional systems and computer-controlled feeding facilities as well as equipment for climate control, air cleaning and energy supply. The scope of services ranges from small to large, fully integrated turn-key farms. Big Dutchman provides customers with all options – from planning to commissioning. State-of-the-art systems for insect farming and high-tech greenhouses complete the product range. The Big Dutchman history dates back to 1938, when the company founders invented the world’s first automatic chain feeder in the USA. The reliable systems can be found across all five continents and in more than 150 countries. Move aims to cut food prices and strengthen national security. title: 01/10/2024 - The History of Big Dutchman | News | Blog | Newquip
content: # The History of Big Dutchman. As the sole mainland UK supplier of Big Dutchman pig and poultry equipment, the Big Dutchman story is very much a Newquip story. Big Dutchman started life in the US with the introduction of the world‘s first automatic chain feeding system in 1938. Thanks to its robust and simple principle, the chain feeding system marked a new era for the poultry industry. The company launched the first liquid feeding system for pigs in 1968, followed by the introduction of manure belt ventilation for cage systems 15 years later, as well as the first Natura aviary system for laying hens. After a management buyout, Josef Meerpohl became the owner of Big Dutchman, with Calveslage the international head office. Big Dutchman has worked tirelessly to improve and adapt over the years to accommodate today’s requirements for modern poultry production. Newquip has supplied Big Dutchman pig and poultry products here in the UK since January 2000.
